notes.title: Gameplay Update
notes.notes:
Dear Commanders,

We will be conducting a major update.
From October 2nd, 08:00 to 14:00 UTC
         October 2nd,  3:00  to 9:00 CST
During this period, game connections will be cut, and the game will not be accessible. Please disconnect in advance to save your game data.

⭐Gameplay Updates:
1.Nine new technologies will be unlocked at the fourth level. Players can unlock these technologies through normal research and complete related missions.

2.The score required to capture star areas has been significantly reduced, while the score gained from star area battles has been greatly increased.
Fixed the issue where star area battle scores were not displayed.

3.The points earned from winning 1V1, 2V2, and multiplayer co-op and challenge stages have been multiplied. Fixed the issue where these types of battles did not award points.

4.Guild tech points for each player have been significantly increased, allowing a smaller number of players to unlock a large amount of guild technology.


Since this update involves several services, the maintenance period will be longer.

Special thanks to the following players for their feedback on the game issues:
 一半释然 灰lux 

Thank you to all the players who support our small team. It is your encouragement and feedback that allow this game to continuously improve and grow!

Wishing all Commanders a pleasant interstellar journey!

Sincerely,
MirrorAlice Studio

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Update Time:

UST (UTC): September 20, 12:00 - 13:00
US CST: September 20, 6:00 AM - 7:00 AM

The server will be down during this time, and you must update the game client to access the game after the update. Using an old version may result in errors or connection issues.

Bug Fixes:
1.Fixed an issue where subsequent technologies couldn't be researched even after prerequisites were 2.completed.
3.Corrected discrepancies between some occupation mission descriptions and actual conditions that 4.prevented completion.
5.Fixed an issue where custom ship skins were not displaying properly in battles.
6.Resolved issues with certain item icons not displaying correctly.
7.Fixed some technology and mission completion detection issues.
8.Addressed potential issues with server reconnections.


Known Issues & Next Week's Update Plan:
1.In StarCompete, matches against AI sometimes cause battlefield changes and no points are awarded. We will redesign AI levels and the required point system in Sector Conquest.
2.Add functions to query and guide players on where to buy and sell trade goods.
3.New early-game combat missions will be added, optimizing the balance and order of early-game combat and story missions.
4.Various UI improvements (to be gradually rolled out over several updates).
5.New video tutorials for combat operations and some interfaces.

notes.title: Gameplay Update
notes.notes:
Dear Commander,

We are rolling out an update. Update Time: 
September 18     12:30 - 12:45 (UST)   / 6:30 AM - 6:45 AM (CST) 
The server will restart, and the Steam client will need to update. Online players will be disconnected.

⭐Gameplay Adjustments

1. Reduced Vessel Endurance penalties for fleets after losing or exiting battles on the star map.
2. Significantly lowered penalties for fleets with low Vessel Endurance. Penalties now only apply when durability is extremely low.
3. Adjusted battle difficulty for star map events and patrol missions.
4. Greatly increased rewards for winning patrol, occupation, and custom battles.
5. Increased Main Base output per period.

⭐Bug Fixes

1. Some battles couldn't be won properly.
2. Some tasks couldn't be completed after dialogues.
3. Research conditions met but unable to proceed.
4. Fleet stuck and unable to move on the star map.
5. Depots, Decisive Hall, or Trade buttons unresponsive after enter a new period

⭐Upcoming Updates Expected by this weekend or early next week:

1. Minor UI improvements – buttons and some backgrounds.
2. New combat missions added to early dialogues.
3. Star map trade optimization, added trade item indicators.
4. Tooltip labels for buttons to clarify their functions.
5. Fix for battleship skins not displaying correctly in combat.



Special thanks to the following players for their feedback:

Your input helped the developers fix bugs and improve the experience more quickly and accurately!

notes.title: Asia Server Launch & Update
notes.notes:
Dear Commanders,

We will perform an important update on
September 12, 17:00-17:30 UTC
September 12, 11:00-11:30 CST

Due to network issues between certain countries, players have experienced frequent disconnections and rollbacks on the global server. To address this, we are launching a new "Asian-Russia Server" located in Guangdong, and the global server will be moved to Ohio.

As these servers are provided by different cloud companies, data cannot be shared between them.

⭐ New Server
When you enter the "Asia/Russia(AS-RUS)" server, you will need to create a new character. 
Your original data will remain on the global server, now called the "NA-EU" server, where you can continue using your existing data.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused by switching servers and have prepared technology point compensation ⭐ which you can claim via mail (shortcut key M) to quickly catch up on lost progress.


Lastly, we have made some additional updates to improve the experience for new players and those replaying early game content. We appreciate your understanding.

⭐ Update Details:
1. Added a server selection screen, allowing you to choose a server each time you start the game.
2. Introduced more intuitive image guides (with more to come) to replace the current text-heavy instructions.
3. Reduced commander tacitc in early levels to minimize distractions for commanders.
4. Added "Decisive Weapons" to some early levels to speed up gameplay and help commanders get familiar with this feature.
5. In the guild page, the activity battles have been updated to "Custom Rooms & Events." 
   - Players can create custom rooms for fun simulations, PvP, or PvE by clicking the left panel and inviting Steam or in-game friends.
   - The right panel contains a task list that must be completed sequentially according to the main storyline.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080065/01677b90d4c8c23b658c615d4e5b3fb7359e97e2.png
6. Adjusted the server’s technology data storage to prevent potential rollback in research progress.
7. Made it less likely to accidentally click the same spot repeatedly in battles.
8. Added prompts for "Ship Deployment Button" and the ability to "swipe left/right" in the deployment panel.
9. Fixed chat issues in the guild interface.

Join our Discord.
Steam Discussions.

Wishing you safe travels through the stars!

Sincerely,
MirrorAlice Studio
